name: 语义配色＋图型专属布局
mapping_rule: 同一图中颜色编码单一主要维度；同语义同色；状态不混用归属色
layout_rule: 按图型表达责任交接、实体关系和基数、参与方与时间、或架构层级
input_policy: 绘图时用户只给逻辑即可；自动选择图型，不再询问风格
content_policy: 结构由用户逻辑决定，不为丰富画面擅自增加业务复杂度

swimlane_preference.layout: horizontal responsibility lanes with neutral stage headers
swimlane_preference.steps: responsibility-colored title bands; labeled decision diamonds
swimlane_preference.resource_lanes: passive data and persistence, not decision makers
swimlane_preference.routes: solid handoffs; dashed current-cycle loops; dotted cross-cycle flow only when applicable
swimlane_preference.density: lane height follows workload; reserve routing corridors
swimlane_preference.scope: reuse visual grammar; derive actors, phases, conditions and topology from the user logic
